# Broke & Fixed Home Solutions

> Family owned, fully insured home remodeling company based in Kendall, FL. Serves Miami-Dade and Broward counties. Bilingual, English and Spanish. Phone (786) 363-7039. Email brokeandfixed305@gmail.com.

Services: bathroom remodeling, kitchen remodeling, interior painting, exterior painting, tile work, exterior repairs, cabinet refinishing, and king tide and saltwater flood damage repair (tear-out, drying and rebuild).

## King tide flood damage, October 2026

- [King tide flood damage repair in Broward and Miami-Dade](https://brokeandfixed.com/en/king-tide-flooding): what the record October 2026 king tide did, what saltwater does to a house, insurance basics, next king tide dates
- [Fort Lauderdale](https://brokeandfixed.com/en/king-tide-flooding/fort-lauderdale): Las Olas Isles, Hendricks and Venice Isles, Himarshee, Mayan Drive
- [Hollywood](https://brokeandfixed.com/en/king-tide-flooding/hollywood): Hollywood Lakes, Hollywood Beach Broadwalk
- [Miami Beach](https://brokeandfixed.com/en/king-tide-flooding/miami-beach): Crespi Boulevard in North Beach, Collins Avenue
- [Miami and Miami Shores](https://brokeandfixed.com/en/king-tide-flooding/miami): Edgewater, Miami Shores canal backflow, Little River
- [En español](https://brokeandfixed.com/es/king-tide-flooding): reparación de daños por marea rey
